personalOrTeamApiKey.label: Personal/Team API Key
personalOrTeamApiKey.description: Used for Coralogix management APIs (for example alert definitions, incidents, dashboards).

sendYourDataApiKey.label: Send-Your-Data API Key
sendYourDataApiKey.description: Used for Coralogix ingestion APIs (for example /logs/v1/singles). Find it in Settings → API Keys → Send Your Data.

coralogixDomain.label: Ingestion Region Domain
coralogixDomain.description: Select your Coralogix regional domain for ingestion endpoints. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

listIncidents.label: List Incidents
listIncidents.description: Retrieve a filtered list of Coralogix incidents.

status.label: Status
status.description: Filter by incident status. Leave empty to return all.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: Filter by incident severity. Leave empty to return all.

applicationName.label: Application Names
applicationName.description: Filter by application name(s). Leave empty to return all.

subsystemName.label: Subsystem Names
subsystemName.description: Filter by subsystem name(s). Leave empty to return all.

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of incidents to return.

getIncidentById.label: Get Incident By ID
getIncidentById.description: Retrieve a Coralogix incident by its incident ID.

incidentId.label: Incident ID
incidentId.description: The Coralogix incident ID to retrieve.

getIncidentEvents.label: Get Incident Events
getIncidentEvents.description: Get related events for a specific incident.

setAlertActive.label: Enable / Disable Alert
setAlertActive.description: Enable or disable a Coralogix alert definition. Use this to mute alerts during maintenance windows.

alertId.label: Alert ID
alertId.description: The ID of the alert to enable or disable. Use the "List Alert Definitions" action to find IDs.

active.label: Enable Alert
active.description: Turn ON to enable the alert, turn OFF to disable it.
